defects.description: Breakers.on_equity can switch the drawdown breaker off for the rest of a UTC day. If the first equity reading of the day is NaN (bankroll() returns NaN when a book has a NaN bid), self.hwm is set to NaN. After that, max(nan, x) stays NaN and dd = NaN > 0.10 is always False. Probe Q7: equity NaN, then 50, then 10 on the same day leaves the state ACTIVE with hwm nan. This fails open, unlike the NaN-safe kernel checks added in this round. While the NaN lasts, the kernel's 1.1x check still rejects new risk, because ctx.bankroll_usd is NaN. The gap stays open after the bad book clears.
defects.fix_hint: At the top of on_equity, ignore a non-finite equity: 'if not math.isfinite(equity_usd): return'. Alternatively, trip REDUCING on it. Either way, hwm is never set to NaN. Add one assert to test_b7_daily_drawdown.

notes: Every criterion was re-checked against the current code; the builder's claims were not taken on trust. Mutation testing (build/phase-1/audit-tmp/WP1-B/mutate2.py, run on scratch copies in audit-tmp/WP1-B/mut2, deleted afterwards): 46 of 50 caught. The 50 are the original 22, rewritten for the current code, plus 28 new ones aimed at the fixes. Four survive, none of them harmful: (1) 'load_advice not read-only': the code only runs a SELECT, and a missing file returns before connecting. (2) 'no record type check': redundant, because load_advice already files only type=='clearance' records under clearances. (3) 'exposure strategy filter dropped': the minor test gap. (4) 'markout no clear after trip': trips are idempotent. Behaviour that matches the design and is not a defect: after a human reset, the drawdown mark re-arms at the trip equity. So a day can lose 10% plus 9.9% without a second trip (probe Q8), because the human accepted the first loss. Unchanged from the builder's open issues, all failing closed or harmless in Phase 1: (a) The GTD start bound fails open after the start or when kernel.starts is empty. Sports modes must close this before going live; there is a ponytail note in gtd(). (b) For WP1-F: refresh ctx.open_orders between check() calls within one tick, and fill kernel.starts. (c) Any caller can use the 'human' or 'loop' prefixes to set HALTED, which errs on the safe side. (d) An invalid clearance row with a later expiry can hide a valid one, which leaves the market not cleared. Scratch files written this round: audit-tmp/WP1-B/probe2.py and mutate2.py. real_cli.py rewrote audit-tmp/WP1-B/cli/*.
